raw.title: Social contract
raw.extract: In moral and political philosophy, the social contract is a theory of state that conceives of a legitimate state as arising from the agreement of citizens who consent to surrender some of their freedoms and submit to the authority in exchange for protection of their remaining rights or maintenance of the social order.
